in_marathi.name: Girija
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of mountains and mother of Lord Ganesha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girija हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Girija is the name of the goddess Parvati, the wife of Lord Shiva. She is also known as Girija or Girijaa, the mother of Lord Ganesha. This name signifies strength, stability, and nurturing love.
